answer_1.quote: open-domain dialogue systems have attracted much research attention, thanks to the success of neural generation models trained with large-scale data.

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation for each dialogue model is performed on 5K test data... The following automatic metrics are used: 1) Perplexity (PPL)... 2) BLEU... 3) Distinct...

answer_4.quote: Manual evaluation is also performed for the generated dialogue responses...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate responses on fluency and coherency using a scale of 0 to 2.
